description:
Schema-debt-external-id lane, 2b-S1 (2026-08-06) — operator-only repair for the duplicate `session_ledger__source` registration defect measured live (eight duplicated `source_kind`s at diagnosis time, across two distinct root-cause mechanisms: a canonicalization-lookup gap that lets a differently-spelled historical row survive alongside a later correctly-canonicalized one, and a pure check-then-insert race for byte-identical export/blob-id sources). Re-points every live child row (`session`, `import_batch`, `source_cursor`, `active_lease`) from `loser_source_id` to `winner_source_id`, verifies the loser is fully orphaned, then soft-deletes it.

Winner selection is NOT performed by this verb — the operator (or the calling repair session) determines `winner_source_id`/`loser_source_id` externally per the two mechanical rules recorded in the findings file (canonical-form match for the normalization-gap pairs; session-count + created_at tiebreak, same precedent as the D2 budget_report join fix, for the byte-identical pairs). An ambiguous winner is a report-back, never a judgment call made inside this verb.

Quiesce is a PRECONDITION this verb partially enforces and partially trusts to the caller. The full protocol (measured against the live importer): disable BOTH pair members (`enabled=false`) so neither the periodic poller (`list_sources(enabled_only=True)`) nor a targeted `poll_source` call (which raises immediately on a disabled source) can start a new poll; wait for any already-in-flight poll's lease to clear; only then call this verb with `confirm=true`. This verb itself refuses `confirm=true` when the loser is still `enabled` or still shows a `polling_lease_until` in the future — a defense-in-depth check, not a substitute for the caller running the full external quiesce sequence first.

Soft-delete only, never hard — the retired row's rollback lever, matching this repository's soft-delete-is-opt-out convention (the `reset_source_cursor` hard-delete is the sole documented exception, for an unrelated reason: a cursor reset has no recovery path).
embedding_description: Operator-only repair: retire a duplicate session_ledger__source row into its canonical winner. Re-points session/import_batch/source_cursor/active_lease child rows from loser_source_id to winner_source_id, verifies orphaned, soft-deletes the loser. Winner selection happens externally, not inside this verb. Refuses confirm=true if the loser is still enabled or has an active polling lease (quiesce-protocol precondition, enforced here as defense-in-depth). Default dry-run reports per-table child counts + loser enabled flag; confirm=true performs the write. Use for the schema-debt-external-id duplicate-source dedup lane.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Duplicate-source retirement outcome. `confirmed=false` is a dry-run reporting `children_to_move` (per-table counts) and `loser_enabled` as sizing/quiesce signals. `confirmed=true` reports `children_moved` (per-table rows-affected) and `loser_retired`.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: On `confirmed=true`, log the returned `children_moved` counts and `loser_source_id` into the lane's findings file per pair — declared-semantics rail, every re-point is logged, never a silent row-count delta. Re-enable the winner source row afterward (this verb does not do so itself) and confirm its next poll cycle picks it up normally.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Re-points `source_id` on four child tables via `update_state`, then soft-deletes (`is_deleted=1`) the loser `session_ledger__source` row — all via StateManagementInterface primitives, never raw SQL.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValueError 'winner_source_id == loser_source_id': same id passed twice, refused before any read. ValueError 'not found or deleted': one of the two ids does not resolve to a live source row. ValueError 'source_kind mismatch': the two rows are not a legitimate duplicate pair. ValueError 'is still enabled': the loser was not disabled first — run the quiesce protocol (disable both rows) before retrying with confirm=true. ValueError 'has an active polling lease': a poll is in flight against the loser — wait for the reported lease deadline to pass. LedgerRepositoryError 'child row(s) still reference ... after re-point': the re-point did not fully clear the loser (a new child row was written mid-repair, most likely because quiesce was skipped or a lease was acquired between the precondition check and the re-point) — re-run the dry-run to re-measure before retrying.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Re-run with `confirm=false` to get a fresh dry-run and re-verify `loser_enabled=false` and the child counts. If refused for an active lease, wait and retry. If refused for still-referenced children after a re-point, the loser was not fully quiesced — repeat the full disable+wait-for-lease sequence before retrying with `confirm=true`. This verb is NOT safely re-callable mid-failure without re-checking state first — unlike `reset_source_cursor`'s pure idempotency, a partial re-point (if one table's `update_state` succeeds and a later one fails) can leave children split across winner and loser; re-run the dry-run to see the current split before deciding whether to retry or investigate.
